description: Fetches a Codex login from the token worker at session start when CODEX_TOKEN_URL is set.

hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/codex-partner/scripts/codex-partner-auth.ts" --quiet; else echo "codex-partner needs Bun (https://bun.sh); the Codex login check was skipped"; fi
